text: The authors prove that if M(T_i, F) satisfies (c, q)-expansion on (S_i^good, T_i) and M'(T_i, F) satisfies (c, q)-expansion on (S_i^bad, T_i), then any classifier f in F that fits the weak labels well on S_i and is fairly robust on T_i, with err(f, weak labels|S_i) plus its non-robust mass on T_i below c(1 - q - alpha_i), has its true error on the uncovered set T_i bounded by an explicit upper bound.
title: Theorem 4.2: coverage expansion error bound for uncovered points
